item.title: PROGRESS WATCH: Construction in Northern Mindanao up 17.2% in 2024
item.description: Construction activity in Northern Mindanao surged by 17.2% in 2024 based in the latest figures released by the Philippine Statistics Authority in Northern Mindanao (PSA-10). The total number of approved constructions rose to 12,095 in 2024, up from 10,324 in 2023. Of these, 9,379 were residential buildings — underscoring a continued strong demand for housing.
